requirement_text.REQ-432:
Follow-on to REQ-373 (service_catalog version/status lifecycle + real PinResolver.Lookup, status: done on the backend) and to REQ-399 (case-detail dependency-version/provenance screen, status: done -- REQ-399 already built the GET /api/v1/instances/{id}/pins route, web/src/hooks/useInstancePins.ts, and web/src/components/instances/InstancePinsPanel.tsx, wired into InstanceDetailPage.tsx). Filed from ISS-0898, split from ISS-0890's WF05-FULL-20260929 PLATFORM UAT report: the platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change scenario (test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/platform/instance-pin-survives-catalog-change.yaml) is BLOCKED not because the read-only provenance screen is missing (REQ-399 built that) but because two operator ACTIONS the scenario's own steps exercise have no UI anywhere, and REQ-399's own SCOPE explicitly excluded one of them: "any UI affordance to CHANGE a pin from this screen... is a separate requirement if one is ever filed."
WHAT EXISTS TODAY, verified 2026-09-30 by direct source read: - `POST /api/v1/admin/services/:service_id/versions` (publish) and
  `POST /api/v1/admin/services/:service_id/retire` (retire) are real,
  shipped REQ-373 routes (lib/letflow/routers/admin_services.ex,
  design doc lib/letflow/design/req373-service-catalog-version-lifecycle.md
  §7), gated by the existing :AdminServicesManage permission. Grepping
  web/src/api/services.ts and web/src/pages/admin/services/ServicesPage.tsx
  for "publish"/"retire"/"version" returns zero hits beyond the existing
  `ServiceRecord` type -- neither route has any frontend client function or
  UI control. An operator today cannot publish a new service-connection
  version or retire an old one from the GUI at all, which is exactly the
  scenario's own step 2 action.
- `POST /instances/:id/rebind-pins` is a real, shipped REQ-078/PIN-05 route
  (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex, `Letflow.Engine.PinRebind.rebind_pins/3`,
  200 response `{instance_id, changes, rebound_at}`, each change item
  carrying `ref`/`prior_version`/`new_version` per the
  `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND` event it appends). Grepping web/src for "rebind"
  returns zero hits beyond REQ-399's own read-only provenance panel and its
  test -- there is no rebind client function, no rebind action/button/dialog
  anywhere in web/src. An operator today cannot deliberately move a running
  case onto a different pinned version from the GUI at all, which is
  exactly the scenario's own step 5 action (with a caller-supplied reason
  -- `rebind_attrs()` requires `:idempotency_key`, per
  lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex's own design notes, and the scenario's
  step 5 input is `reason: \"External system retires the old endpoint at
  month end.\"`).
- Case history rendering: grepped web/src for any existing generic
  event-timeline renderer capable of showing an `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND`
  entry with actor/prior_version/new_version/reason (EO-005's own evidence
  requirement, "the case history shows the change with the operator's
  name, the previous and new version, and the reason given") -- confirm at
  implementation time whether InstanceDetailPage.tsx's existing
  history/timeline section already renders arbitrary event types generically
  (in which case this requirement only needs the rebind action itself to
  produce the right event, already true by construction since
  `rebind_pins/3` already appends the real event) or needs a
  dedicated case for this event type -- do not assume either way without
  checking.

THIS REQUIREMENT BUILDS: (1) a typed `publish`/`retire` client pair in web/src/api/services.ts and UI controls on web/src/pages/admin/services/ServicesPage.tsx (a "publish new version" action taking the publish_attrs() fields plus a version string, and a "retire" action) for a PLATFORM_ADMIN-equivalent operator; (2) a typed `rebind` client function (POST /instances/:id/rebind-pins) and a rebind action/dialog on REQ-399's InstancePinsPanel.tsx (or InstanceDetailPage.tsx) requiring the caller to supply a reason string, wired to the real endpoint; (3) confirm, and if needed extend, the case history/timeline rendering so an `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND` entry's actor, prior_version, new_version and reason are all visible per EO-005; (4) the named pipeline_test spec.
OUT OF SCOPE: any change to `Letflow.ServiceCatalog`, `PinResolver`, `PinRebind`, or any of REQ-373/REQ-399's already-shipped routes (pure frontend consumption/action wiring against already-shipped endpoints); re-scoping or modifying REQ-399's read-only provenance display beyond what is needed to add the rebind action to the same screen; PLC-01/module_ref catalog versioning (still the identical, already-named SCOPE GAP pin_resolver.ex's own moduledoc states, unscoped to any stage, restated by both REQ-373 and REQ-399).

task.description: WF-02 Step 3 (test design) for REQ-432, frontend-only. Scope test result (ORCH): executable surface EXISTS (web/ TypeScript logic with 39 new unit/component tests plus a Playwright pipeline spec written by FRONTEND-DEV in Step 2b), so run the full procedure. Verify branch feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930. Follow docs/agents/workflows/WF-02_requirement_implementation.md Step 3, .claude/agents/test-designer.md and docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md. Precedent for a frontend-requirement test spec: test/specs/REQ-399.md and test/specs/REQ-383.md (read them). Deliverables: (A) test/specs/REQ-432.md: requirement text / acceptance criteria restated, then for EACH of the nine acceptance criteria in task.acceptance_criteria the named test file(s) and test case name(s) that prove it and why each would FAIL if the criterion were violated (mutation reasoning), mapped against the existing tests listed in step-02b-frontend-dev.json result.artifacts_out; state honestly which criteria are proven by unit/component tests and which only by the pipeline spec that has NOT yet run green (Keycloak on localhost:8094 shadowed by wslrelay on this host), and that the 'in-flight step completes without error' half of the retire AC is unverifiable on success because of backend gap M5 (ServiceTaskDispatcher.catalog_lookup_stub/2 unconditional {:error,:not_registered}; see design section 7.3/9). The git-diff AC (no file under lib/letflow/service_catalog*, pin_resolver.ex, pin_rebind.ex) is proven by command, say so. (B) Fix the REVIEWER's four MINOR findings in step-02d-reviewer.json result.issues, which are test-artefact defects: 1) web/tests/e2e/pipelines/platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts step 07 asserts count()==0 after a fixed waitForTimeout with no positive anchor -- add a positive presence assertion for the rendered page (heading / panel / a control the worker can see) before the absence counts, and remove the reliance on the fixed timeout where a web-first assertion can replace it (see docs/anti-patterns.md Playwright entries, e.g. grep -n 'Playwright' docs/anti-patterns.md); 2) web/src/components/instances/__tests__/InstancePinsPanel.rebind.test.tsx test 'a running case keeps showing its old version after the service was retired (EO-004)' is near-tautological -- make it a real test that can fail (for example render the ServicesPage retire flow and the InstancePinsPanel against independent mocked APIs in one test and assert the retire call is made while the pins panel and its Rebind affordance remain rendered with the old version and no error state, OR rename/re-scope the claim honestly so it does not over-claim; pick the option you can make genuinely falsifiable, prove falsifiability by a quick local mutation you then revert); 3) add a short header comment to the pipeline spec stating it has not been run against a live backend at authoring time and listing the unproven selector assumptions (steps 02/07); 4) the 200-event join bound is a documented MINOR: if a unit test for it is cheap (history row falls back to the actor UUID prefix when the timeline lacks the event), add it to web/src/pages/instances/__tests__/InstanceDetailPage.actorNames.test.tsx or confirm one already exists. You may edit ONLY test files, test/specs/REQ-432.md, and the scenario yaml comment if needed -- NOT web/src non-test files (a production-code defect you find goes in result.issues for ORCH to route to FRONTEND-DEV). After edits run from web/ and QUOTE real output: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run guards (and npx playwright test --list for the spec). Do not run the e2e spec live. Tests must use no wall-clock time or unseeded randomness, unique per-test data, no hardcoded secrets. Commit by explicit filename (never git add -A) and push to origin feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930. Lint your handoff: mix letflow.lint_handoffs --dir handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-03-test-designer.json. Claim by setting status IN_PROGRESS only; on finish set COMPLETED/FAILED, fill result (artifacts_out lists every file touched, not the handoff file), real-clock completed_at; never edit task/created_at/started_at; do not write registry.json. Run everything synchronously in the foreground; never use background processes.

result.summary: Wrote test/specs/REQ-432.md mapping all nine requirements.yaml acceptance criteria (the handoff's task.acceptance_criteria lists five step-level criteria; the nine are REQ-432's own) to named vitest/pipeline tests with mutation reasoning and an explicit honesty statement: AC2-AC5, AC9 and the UI halves of AC6/AC7 are proven by green vitest tests; AC1 and the live halves of AC6/AC7 are proven only by the pipeline spec, which has NOT run green (Keycloak localhost:8094 shadowed by wslrelay; spec compiles and lists, 1 test); the in-flight-step-completes half of AC7 is unverifiable on success because of backend gap M5 (catalog_lookup_stub/2); AC8 proven by command (git diff --name-only main...HEAD | grep service_catalog|pin_resolver|pin_rebind -> no output, exit 1; only lib/ file is the design doc). Four REVIEWER MINORs fixed: (1) pipeline step 07 now uses web-first toBeVisible anchors (Services heading; instance-pins-panel) then toHaveCount(0), waitForTimeout removed; (2) EO-004 test replaced with a cross-module test rendering real ServicesPage + InstancePinsPanel on independent mocks, asserting retire called, getPins not refetched, old version/Rebind button present, no error UI; mutation retireMutation.onSuccess -> invalidateQueries() made it fail ('expected spy to be called 1 times, but got 2 times'), reverted via git checkout; (3) spec header states not run live + unproven step 02/07 selector assumptions; (4) new unit test for the 200-event join fallback (UUID prefix, never 'system') in InstanceDetailPage.actorNames.test.tsx; mutation returning 'system' made it fail (1 failed | 1 passed), reverted. Gates from web/: type-check clean; lint clean (--max-warnings 0); npm test 150 files / 995 tests passed; guards 4 files / 52 tests passed; npx playwright test --list: Total: 1 test in 1 file. mix letflow.check.test not run: no Elixir test files touched (frontend-only). No non-test file under web/src changed (git status showed only test files). Commit 17c4e2f3 pushed to origin/feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930.
